form.label: Hexward findings
form.description: Findings from Hexward Labs tools (Hexward Finding Schema v1).

search.query: eventtype=hexward_finding | stats latest(event) AS e BY id | where e!="resolved" | stats count
eventtype=hexward_finding_opened | stats count BY severity | eval order=case(severity="critical",1,severity="high",2,severity="medium",3,severity="low",4,true(),5) | sort order | fields - order
eventtype=hexward_finding (event="opened" OR event="resolved") | timechart count BY event
eventtype=hexward_finding_opened | table _time product severity signature dest description | head 50
